rules: Only pre-existing units may be committed unless a separate construction/commissioning event created new units.
A war cannot materialize fleets to match an encounter difficulty target.
Units already assigned elsewhere remain unavailable unless actually reassigned.
Readiness, damage, crew, travel time and logistics affect usable force.
Mobilization consumes time unless already-deployed forces are used.
Detailed economic production/supply networks remain Block 4; Block 3 consumes available logistics summaries.
